en: Improved start-up time: a session started soon after another no longer waits for the model list, and one outside a git repository without `.claude/settings.local.json` no longer waits on git
zh: 改进启动时间：紧接另一个 session 启动的 session 不再等待模型列表；在 git 仓库之外且没有 `.claude/settings.local.json` 的 session 不再等待 git
